description: Generic positioning, substitutable claims, weak differentiation
page_text: We are a leading AI consulting firm helping organizations transform their business with cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions. Our team of experts leverages machine learning and data science to unlock value and drive innovation. We offer end-to-end AI services from strategy to implementation. Contact us today to start your AI journey.
rationale: Opens with capability, not problem. 'Leading', 'cutting-edge', 'unlock value', 'leverage' all banned. Zero specific claims. Competitor could paste this unchanged.
